{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Filter to converted customers
converted_df = df[df['converted'] == 1]

# Check how many converted customers have age = -1 (missing)
missing_age_converted = (converted_df['customer_age'] == -1).sum()
print(f"Number of converted customers with age = -1: {missing_age_converted}")

# Exclude -1 values (sentinel) and compute mean age
valid_converted_age = converted_df[converted_df['customer_age'] != -1]['customer_age']
mean_age_converted = valid_converted_age.mean()

print(f"Mean age of converted customers (excluding -1): {mean_age_converted:.2f}")

# Confirm the count
print(f"Number of valid converted customers (age != -1): {len(valid_converted_age)}")"}
